assets.name: heart
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is reference for an isolated Godot UI icon asset. Reconstruct ONLY this one icon: red pixel heart with pink highlight, upper HUD health icon. Match original chunky crisp pixel-art silhouette, dark navy outline, vivid limited palette and pixel shading; enlarge faithfully not painterly. Complete standalone object, centered in square with 10% empty padding. No text, numbers, HUD panels, enclosing badge, other icons, watermark, blur or cast shadow. Actual transparent alpha background required; if actual alpha is impossible use perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF magenta background, never checkerboard. No magenta pixels in object.
